entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you with your VeloFit products today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, may I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It doesn't matter. I just don't want it. Can I return it or not?

I understand you want a direct answer. I just have to note that for wearable electronics, our return **policy** can be quite specific. For certain items, after two weeks it's often considered **too late** to process a return, primarily due to **hygiene** and user **sanitation** concerns.
So you're saying I can't return it? This is wasting my time.

No, not at all, please let me clarify. I was speaking generally. Let me check the specifics for your exact product... Okay, good news. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor is actually covered under our previous 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Okay. Finally. What do I need to do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email within the next 15 minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
